description: USGS Historical Topographic Map Collection (HTMC) GeoTIFFs for the Tri-State Systems Manager anchor area (Point Township, Posey County, Indiana, and neighboring quads). Acquired 2026-11-05.
acquisitionRoute: USGS National Map TNM Access API v1 (https://tnmaccess.nationalmap.gov/api/v1/products?datasets=Historical Topographic Maps&bbox=...&prodFormats=GeoTIFF); downloadURL fields point at the USGS prd-tnm S3 staged products used by TopoView (https://ngmdb.usgs.gov/topoview/viewer/). No sign-in required; public domain (U.S. federal).
discoveryNote: Quad/year coverage was verified in the TopoView viewer in the browser on 2026-11-05 (see ~/workspace/research_notes/topoview-tsm-analysis-2026-11-05.md). Where TNM and TopoView disagree on an edition label, both are recorded; nothing was substituted silently.
evidenceClassStatement: These are scanned historical map images with embedded georeferencing. They are cartographic reference only: NOT a DEM, NOT bare-earth LiDAR terrain, NOT surveyed bathymetry, NOT flood-zone or gauge data, and NOT a substitute for current bare-earth DEM, lidar-derived terrain, surveyed bathymetry, or authoritative vertical-control data. They support historical landscape/context review (river-channel, road, rail, and place-name change) and source discovery only. They must not be promoted to an engineering input without separate artifact, datum, coverage, resolution, and accuracy checks.
selectionRule: One variant acquired per quad/year: the earliest-cataloged (2018-02-18) TNM scan, lowest file ID among that batch. TNM returns multiple records for the same quad/year (duplicate scans of the same map, identical titles and publication dates); the unacquired duplicates are listed per file under duplicateTnmRecords.
